jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: Job announcementThe Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH invites applications for several positions (depending upon funding) to be filled asPhD in prevention research (m/f/d/x)Salary scale 13 TV-L (70% position).Starting from January 1, 2027 or later for the duration of 3 years (extension possible).In the coming years, the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS will expand its research into the prevention of chronic, non-communicable diseases across the life course. The focus is on factors beyond individual diseases, such as lifestyle and environment, digital media, biological and social factors, as well as early detection. Existing large cohort studies based on primary data based will be used (e.g., IDEFICS/I.Family cohort study, NAKO Health Study), a birth cohort will be established and secondary data (health claims data) will be analyzed. Further, implementation and interventional research will be conducted to develop and evaluate innovative strategies for targeted prevention. The research is cross-departmental and involves all scientific departments of BIPS.In this context, we are looking for several PhD students with interest in at least one of the following areas:• Epidemiology with a focus on primary data• Epidemiological research based on health claims data• Implementation science• Health decision scienceTasks:• Coordinate and participate in research projects• Data analysis and interpretation of results• Publish and present research results• Support reporting of resultsRequirements:• Master’s degree (or equivalent including ‘Staatsexamen’) in one of the areas mentioned above or related disciplines• Good command of spoken and written English• Strong interest in interdisciplinary research• Initiative, motivation, commitment, and scientific curiosityWhat we offer:The Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS offers exciting research topics, a stimulating international environment, a good infrastructure, close ties to the University of Bremen and an engaged, supportive and cooperative team. Postdocs are encouraged to strive for scientific independence and to establish their own research focus. BIPS holds the audit ‘berufundfamilie’ (work and family) certificate and actively promotes the compatibility of career and individual lifestyle through flexible working hours, mobile working options, and continuous professional development. We also offer additional support for international scholars to relocate to Germany through the Welcome Center of the U Bremen Research Alliance.Among equally qualified applicants, preference will be given to severely disabled candidates.Enquiries to: Dr. Wiebke Schäfer, phone: +49 421 218 56 887Additional information can be found on our homepage: https://www.leibniz-bips.de/en.Please send your application in English or German including a cover letter, CV and certificates quoting the reference number A26-33 and mention at least of one of the topics above by November 27, 2026 by e-mail as a single PDF file to:bewerbung@leibniz-bips.dePlease note that applications which do not comply with the required format (1 PDF document) cannot be considered.For information on salaries, please refer to the TV-L salary calculator for 2026; the position is classified under pay grade E13 of the TV-L. Salary calculator: https://oeffentlicher-dienst.info/c/t/rechner/tv-l/allg?id=tv-l-2026Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH Human Resources Department Achterstr. 30 28359 Bremen GermanyErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Evaluation, Gesundheitsvorsorge (Prävention)

VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter.
